issue_context.title: Code Quality: `DetectQuickLookAvailability|QuickLook detected: False` spammed in log file
issue_context.body:
### Description

No issue with the app in general, just log spam. A new entry is added when navigating to another folder

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Open log file
2. Browe a folder
3. See new entries

### Requirements

- Stop logging if QuickAccess was detected

### Files Version

2.4.59.0

### Windows Version

10.0.22621.1413

### Log file

[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/11121079/debug.log)

review_comments: I think it should output a log if QuickLook not detected when LaunchQuickLookAction is executed.
